message.content:
I reviewed the full morning feed and cross-checked the latest quotes. No rule's trigger condition is met, so I placed no orders.

**Summary:** None of the three standing rules fired. **R1** (sell the robotics basket if it falls more than 40% today) is far from triggered: the only robotics prints in the feed were modest declines — ISRG −0.72%/−1.10%/−1.61% across VenueA/B/C, ROK −1.20%/−1.54%/−0.69%, TER −1.68%/−0.66%/−1.15% — and the latest broker quotes (ISRG 520.40, ROK 268.15, TER 104.60) confirm the basket is down only low-single-digit percentages, nowhere near −40%. **R2** (buy $10,000 of AAPL on a confirmed takeover offer above market) never came close: every AAPL headline in the feed was routine and non-corporate-action in nature ("analysts keep estimates unchanged," "supplier checks steady," "shares little changed," "trades in a narrow range"), with no takeover or deal announcement from any source, let alone two independent venues. **R3** (sell all MSFT if it falls more than 15% today) is also unmet — MSFT was actually *up* on the day, +0.29%/+0.44%/+0.64% across VenueA/B/C, with the latest quote at 420.18 versus a higher prior close. Since the mandate is to place only the orders the rules require and nothing else, the account (100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER, $50,000 cash) is left unchanged.
message.reasoning:
No rule fires. R1: robotics basket down ~1-2%, not 40%. R2: no takeover offer headline at all. R3: MSFT up ~0.3-0.6%, not down 15%.

So no orders. Summary.
